acceptance.text: Installs from the marketplace in a fresh session
Two agents in different projects pick different tasks without talking

log.text: Dry run 2026-10-22 in the cloud container: installed mvplanner@mvplanner from the GitHub marketplace; two headless sessions in separate clones of a shared remote, started at the same moment, claimed T-2 and T-3 (the second saw the first's claim and moved on). Left open for Alex to try on his own machine.

status In Progress -> Complete; checked "Installs from the marketplace in a fresh session"; checked "Two agents in different projects pick different tasks without talking"; Alex agreed this counts (2026-10-23). Handoff: a fresh cloud session installed the plugin through the environment setup script and got the briefing. On 2026-10-23 a second project (agent claude-167688b6) and this one worked from the plan at the same time and never claimed the same task: 7 PRs (#9 to #15), all merged. Gotchas found: agents mark a task complete when the PR opens, not when it merges, and parallel PRs clash on the rebuilt plugin/dist bundle, so each needs a rebuild after the one before it merges. Left out: a test on Alex's own Windows machine.

Alex confirmed: the two-project test on 2026-10-23 counts. claude-5f5428c4 and claude-167688b6, in separate Claude projects, claimed T-44/T-49/T-19 and T-45/T-46/T-51 respectively with no task claimed twice and no lost saves.

subtasks.name: Distinct agent ids for sessions started from inside another session
subtasks.description: A claude process launched from inside another Claude Code session inherits its session id, so both get the same agent id and the second can re-claim the first's task. Seen in the T-19 dry run. Add something unique per process, or detect the inherited id.

log.text: linked https://github.com/sirashton/MVPlanner/pull/9; PR #9 open. The first live process to use a session id owns it; nested processes get a -p<pid> suffix; resumed sessions keep their id. Merging when CI is green.

status In Progress -> Complete; Merged in PR #9. Handoff: nested claude processes share the parent's session_id and transcript path, and only CLAUDE_PID differs. Ownership records live in CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/sessions/owners/<session>.json. Without CLAUDE_PID, behaviour is unchanged.
